title: Majority amplification of success probability
statement: Let $E$ be a verifier model closed under majority amplification, let $K\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $\varepsilon,\eta\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0\le\varepsilon$ and $2(1-4\varepsilon^2)^{\lfloor K/2\rfloor}\le\eta$. If a language $L$ is decidable using $E$ with success probability at least $1/2+\varepsilon$ on every input, then it is decidable using $E$ with success probability at least $1-\eta$ on every input.
hypotheses_covered: A verifier model $E$ closed under majority amplification
A language $L$ decidable using $E$ with success probability at least $1/2+\varepsilon$
